parse_rate_limit_headers: parse x-ratelimit-* HTTP headers into a RateLimitState object with per-minute and per-hour buckets
create_RateLimitBucket: create a RateLimitBucket dataclass instance tracking limit, remaining, reset time, and capture timestamp
create_RateLimitState: create a RateLimitState dataclass aggregating requests and tokens rate-limit buckets for min and hour windows
format_rate_limit_display: format a RateLimitState into a multi-line display with usage bars, percentages, and warnings for high usage
format_rate_limit_compact: format a RateLimitState into a single-line compact summary with RPM, RPH, TPM, TPH values
